description: Turn a product page URL (or raw HTML) into clean JSON: name, brand, SKU/GTIN/MPN, price, currency, availability/in_stock, images, rating, review count and every offer, read from schema.org JSON-LD, microdata and OpenGraph. Add include=markdown for an LLM-ready Markdown copy of the page, or include=jsonld for the raw blocks. Use it for price checks, competitor monitoring and catalog enrichment. Sites that block bots or render prices only with JavaScript can return price null; the result says where the price came from (price_source).

html.description: Raw HTML instead of a URL (max 2 MB)

include.description: Comma list of parts: product, meta, markdown, jsonld

name: extract_product
title: Extract product data from a page
